body:
Also:

- Add appearance to the UA stylesheet
- Document remaining issues; explicitly define appearance: none for progress/meter
- Hook into CSS UI's 'native appearance' term

---

Changes needed for this PR:

- [x] Remove *include background properties flag* (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4857#issuecomment-525261650)
- [x] Remove the check for *authorProps* matching the initial value (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4857#issuecomment-628802913)
  - [intent to ship](https://groups.google.com/a/chromium.org/d/msg/blink-dev/uNKeyd8091A/eBJIdtXqAgAJ)
- [x] Remove specification for `appearance: none` for `progress` and `meter` (https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4857#issuecomment-629213057)
- [x] Change `button` to not be applicable to non-buttons
  - [intent to ship](https://groups.google.com/a/chromium.org/d/msg/blink-dev/QFXFzfQtlKk/YPOZLSoXCwAJ)
- [x] Decide what to do with "auto" in the UA stylesheet: https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4857#issuecomment-637595011
